projects.title: Family Archive
projects.summary: A quiet memorial photo & family archive.
projects.fullDescription: A full-stack family memorial archive engineered for longevity, instant media delivery, and effortless mobile administration.
highlights: Git-backed CMS: Automated image compression and JSON publishing via GitHub API & Telegram Webhook bot.
Zero-latency UX: Progressive blur-up images, offline PWA caching, and optimistic comment drawers.
Hardened API: FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend with PBKDF2 hashing, JWT auth, and custom rate limiting.
